Ingénieur d'Alexandrie. Il décrit des au: Engineer of Alexandria. He described automata, siphons and a sphere spun by steam.
Penseur chinois. Ses disciples, les mohi: Chinese thinker. His followers, the Mohists, studied the lever, the balance and the camera obscura.
Maître de l'université de Paris. Il expl: Master at the University of Paris. He explained the motion of projectiles by impetus.
Savant hollandais. Il construit en 1656: Dutch scientist. In 1656 he built the first pendulum clock.
Bourgmestre de Magdebourg. Ses hémisphèr: Mayor of Magdeburg. His evacuated hemispheres resisted sixteen horses.
Ingénieur écossais. Son condenseur sépar: Scottish engineer. His separate condenser made the steam engine far more efficient.
Brasseur et physicien anglais. Il mesure: English brewer and physicist. He measured the equivalence of work and heat.
Physicien autrichien. Il explique la cha: Austrian physicist. He explained heat and entropy by the motion of atoms.
Physicien allemand. En 1900, il découpe: German physicist. In 1900 he divided light's energy into quanta.
Peintre et ingénieur. Ses carnets dessin: Painter and engineer. His notebooks drew gears, machines and studies of flight.
Physicien américain. Il mesure la vitess: American physicist. He measured the speed of light with unprecedented precision and, with Edward Morley, found no trace of the ether. Nobel prize in physics in 1907.
